item.title: Issues and Use of Rare Earth Elements in Energy Transition
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the challenges and applications of rare earth elements within the context of energy transition. The call invites research exploring the various dimensions of rare earth element utilization as societies shift toward sustainable energy systems.

item.title: Critical Dimensions of the Global Energy Transition
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the global energy transition from fossil fuels to low-carbon technologies, addressing the systemic transformation required to mitigate climate change and achieve sustainable development. The call seeks applied, problem-solving research that explores the interplay between technological innovation, policy frameworks, market dynamics, and geopolitical factors across different geographical contexts.

The special issue welcomes contributions on energy sector management, simulation tools, circular economy approaches, and integrated models that assess economic and environmental pathways. Research should address challenges such as green finance, supply chain resilience, carbon neutrality, and policy mechanisms for successful energy transitions, as well as emerging topics including leadership development, gender issues, and professional training in the energy sector.

Appel publié par International Journal of Energy Sector Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

item.title: Critical Raw Materials
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on critical raw materials (CRMs) and their role in global resource and energy economics. Critical raw materials are essential to modern industries including renewable energy, electronics, defense, and advanced manufacturing, yet their supply chains face significant vulnerabilities including geographic concentration, geopolitical tensions, and limited recycling infrastructure.

The issue welcomes research examining the economic, political, and environmental dimensions of critical raw material markets. This includes analyses of supply chain resilience, market mechanisms, policy interventions, technological solutions, and corporate strategies for ensuring sustainable access to these essential resources.

Appel publié par Resource and Energy Economics. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Supply chain security and risk assessment for critical raw materials
  • Geopolitical dimensions of critical raw material markets
  • Technological innovation and substitution strategies
  • Recycling, circular economy, and material recovery
  • Environmental and social impacts of critical raw material extraction
  • Market dynamics and price volatility
  • Policy frameworks and trade regulations
  • Corporate strategies for resource security

Timeline

  • July 1, 2026: Submission deadline
